run_simulation_mean_scores: run a Monte-Carlo simulation to compute mean score estimates for both players over multiple rounds
run_iterated_game: run an iterated game contest for a given number of rounds with specified strategy functions
compute_overall_scores: compute final average scores for both row and column players from game history
get_game_payoffs: get the payoff tuple for a given row and column strategy from a payoff matrix
get_bos_payoff_matrix: get the Battle of the Sexes game payoff matrix with row and column player rewards
